avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone, decreasing potassium excretion; combined supplementation significantly increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed by physician; monitor serum potassium levels regularly

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and impair benazepril's antihypertensive effect; increases acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Use acetaminophen instead; if NSAIDs necessary, use lowest dose for shortest duration with renal monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: ARBs (Angiotensin II Receptor Blockers)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dual renin-angiotensin system blockade increases hyperkalemia, hypotension, and acute kidney injury risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination therapy; use only under direct physician supervision if clinically indicated

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Licorice promotes sodium retention and potassium loss, potentially counteracting benazepril's antihypertensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Limit licorice consumption; monitor blood pressure response

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild stimulant properties that could interfere with blood pressure control
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; use cautiously with physician awareness

avoid_foods.name: High-potassium foods (excessive intake)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive intake of potassium-rich foods (bananas, oranges, spinach, tomatoes, salt substitutes) increases hyperkalemia risk in ACE inhibitor users
avoid_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary potassium intake; avoid potassium-based salt substitutes; do not drastically increase high-K foods

caution_foods.name: Sodium intake
caution_foods.mechanism: High sodium intake may reduce benazepril's antihypertensive efficacy
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium restriction per DASH diet guidelines for optimal blood pressure control

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum creatinine, potassium, and blood pressure regularly, especially within 1-2 weeks of initiation and after dose adjustments. Assess renal function before combining with other medications affecting the renin-angiotensin system.
